name: stats-chunk1224
note: Stat registration, prefix lookup, and the bottom-up print from stats.cpp (1-150).
auditSeams: Exact lookup uses strcasecmp. A prefix match uses strncmp, so the prefix is case-sensitive. A second prefix clears the partial and the lookup returns null when nothing matched exactly. An empty query matches every name as a prefix. The destructor steps to the next node's next link, so only even positions from the head are unlinked. Deleting the middle node of a three-node list follows a null next pointer. Print subtracts the font height plus one, ignores a newline that is the last character, and skips an empty string after GetStats. The virtual size uses the 2D drawer, and the vertical start uses the passed drawer. x is 5 divided by the console scale. The stat command treats argc 2 as the only toggle form.
auditRationale: UNCredited stats.cpp 1-150 (+150). The file ends at 150. A full tally line scan shows no overlap.
auditUncreditedRangeCheck: uncredited_range_check.py --file src/common/engine/stats.cpp --start 1 --end 150 and a full tally line scan → no overlap.
